text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"Do you know the princess named Kawakami 
Princess?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-senpai, please pace with me 
today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wha, I was first... right!? I believe 
people ought to wait their turn!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, calm down, both of you. Why 
don't you two just compete in a mock race 
together?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And I shall crush them both beneath my 
hooves!

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"Her running and way of life were wild and 
fierce. And they shone with immense 
strength—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! I get to have another talk session 
with Sweep-san, don't I?♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm the main star, though!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Please don't be so selfish! The 
star is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —It's the two of us, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"Show respect to your rivals. And in doing 
so, hone yourself to surpass them—"
(Woooooaaaaahhh!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Everyo~ne! Thank you so much for watching 
us in action~!

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: Big sis, you were so cool!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Don't baby her like that. Princess, 
you can get even stronger than this!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Because you're the one we look up to!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, thank you kindly for both the warm 
words and the stern ones♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then please, feel free to keep watching 
me. For I have no intention of stopping 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can remain true to myself, and 
keep shining as a princess."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I shall continue running down my own path.

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"Constantly moving forward, captivating 
others with her back. What a wonderful... 
princess she is."

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text:
"The Legendary Princess: Kawakami 
Princess! Sales and rentals start today!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...My video is right next to the PreFie 
shelf.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
"A lot has happened since that live 
broadcast... but we're finally able to 
release it on disc, which takes a huge 
weight off our shoulders."

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
It ended up being a documentary format 
rather than the anime format you like, 
Kawakami Princess-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, not at all! This way is much...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because I feel like... I might actually be 
able to convey the feelings I want to 
share.

—I received that message just as I reached 
the three-year milestone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...A feature story on me?

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though we call it a feature, it isn't 
for TV broadcast; we plan to release it to 
the world as a standalone film.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
In coordination with the Contents and Film 
Divisions, we are also considering 
expansion into physical sales, rentals, 
and streaming services.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. But compared to what Kawakami 
Princess-san is trying to teach the 
younger generation, mine is completely 
insignificant.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
—Because she's trying to build a new era 
alongside her juniors, after all.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mommy! I'm borrowing this!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, this isn't an anime, you know? The 
outfits are super cute, though... It might 
be way too hard to follow and put you 
right to sleep?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: "I don't care! This is the one I want!!"

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Kawakami, Princess...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ? Yes. I am Kawakami Princess, but...?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!! Really?! Is it the real thing?! 
Wow!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
You know, I want to be just like you! 
Someone like you who—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: —I want to be a super amazing princess!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am sure you can become one too. The 
ideal princess meant just for you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And you will surely find your very own 
Prince who believes in that and walks 
alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
A prince?! Is a prince... someone like 
Daddy?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it could be someone like Papa, or it 
could be someone like Mama. Or perhaps it 
won't even be a human at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yet as long as you keep striving to seize 
your dreams, I'm sure you will find your 
true wish and the finest encounters along 
the way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I was like that too, after all. Right, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So, young lady, you too must follow 
the path you believe in, alright?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Your path to becoming a princess has only 
just begun, after all!"

Kawakami Princess... the ultimate princess 
gave the little girl a radiant smile.
